description: This file defines the DSNConfigurator class for configuring PHPMailer instances via Data Source Strings (DSN). It includes methods to parse DSNs, configure SMTP settings, and apply various options to PHPMailer objects.

classes.name: DSNConfigurator
classes.description: A class to configure a PHPMailer instance based on a Data Source Name (DSN) string. Provides methods to parse the DSN, apply configuration, and set up SMTP details.

methods.name: mailer
methods.description: Creates and configures a new PHPMailer instance based on the provided DSN string, acting as a static factory method.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Applies configuration to a given PHPMailer object based on the parsed DSN string.

methods.name: parseDSN
methods.description: Parses the DSN string into a configuration array, handling errors for malformed DSNs.

methods.name: applyConfig
methods.description: Applies protocol scheme and connection options to the PHPMailer object based on the DSN configuration.

methods.name: configureSMTP
methods.description: Configures SMTP-specific settings on the PHPMailer object based on the DSN.

methods.name: configureOptions
methods.description: Sets additional options on the PHPMailer object, validating keys against allowed options.

methods.name: parseUrl
methods.description: A wrapper around PHP's parse_url to work around PHP 5.5 bugs, extracting URL components including query string if present.
